backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining an Inquiry type and two methods: `submitInquiry` to store contact form submissions with a timestamp, and `getAllInquiries` to return all stored inquiries as an array.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with their IDs, titles, associated files, component dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels — covering OurLegacy page, routing, navigation, and branding consistency.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing short descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing their purpose, styling conventions, and key content for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, border, chart, and sidebar color variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with full SEO metadata including title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Card tags, and JSON-LD structured data for the Nexiris Global organization.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up ModalContext, QueryClient, and TanStack Router with three routes (/, /annual-program, /our-legacy) wrapped in a Layout component containing Navigation, Footer, and InquiryModal.
frontend/src/components/annual/FAQSectio: A FAQ section for the annual program page that renders a list of six accordion items covering verification reports, turnaround times, pricing, and Trade Trust Score details.
frontend/src/components/annual/PricingSe: A pricing section displaying two plan cards—Single Report ($649) and Annual Program ($5,499)—with feature lists and enquire buttons, used on the annual program page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, services links (including scroll-to-section buttons and router links to Annual Program and Our Legacy), and a contact column with email and address — styled in dark brand colors with Minty Blue accents.
frontend/src/components/home/AnnualProgr: A home-page section showing Single Report and Annual Program pricing cards with feature lists and enquire buttons, similar to the annual page's PricingSection but with slight feature differences.
frontend/src/components/home/Credibility: A home-page section displaying three animated count-up statistics (years of experience, verifications completed, independence) with a scroll-triggered animation and a supporting quote.
frontend/src/components/home/FinalCTASec: A full-width call-to-action section at the bottom of the home page with a headline, subtext, a consultation enquiry button, and a direct email contact link.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Full-screen hero section with a video background, animated headline, subheading, CTA buttons, and a stats row for the Nexiris Global landing page.
frontend/src/components/home/HowItWorksS: Four-step process section explaining the verification workflow from request submission to report delivery, with scroll-triggered animations.
frontend/src/components/home/ProblemSect: Section highlighting three key trade risks (counterparty risk, regulatory exposure, documentation failures) using animated cards with scroll-triggered visibility.
frontend/src/components/home/TradeScoreS: Displays the proprietary Trade Trust Score™ with an SVG radar chart and progress bars across five verification dimensions.
frontend/src/components/home/WhatWeDeliv: Lists eight deliverables included in every verification report in a two-column checklist layout with scroll animations.
frontend/src/components/InquiryModal.tsx: A dialog modal component for submitting consultation inquiries with form fields for name, company, email, and message, including validation, submission via a React Query mutation, and a success state.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: A fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, smooth-scroll links to page sections, route links to internal pages, and a mobile hamburger menu that triggers the inquiry modal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, switching between anonymous and authenticated actors based on Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: React hook that animates a number from a start to end value over a given duration using requestAnimationFrame, with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Computer Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a `useSubmitInquiry` mutation hook using TanStack Query that submits an inquiry form to the backend actor and invalidates the inquiries query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to return a ref and `isVisible` boolean for scroll-triggered animations, with immediate visibility for users who prefer reduced motion.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, brand gradient utilities, and scroll animation keyframes/classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AnnualProgram.tsx: Annual Program page that renders the PricingSection and FAQSection components, passing the global modal opener as the enquire callback.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes all homepage sections (Hero, Problem, What We Deliver, TradeScore, Annual Program, Credibility, Final CTA) and wires the enquiry modal to each relevant section.
frontend/src/pages/OurLegacy.tsx: Our Legacy page presenting Nexiris Global's heritage from Nexiris Consultants, with scroll-animated sections, an external link to the firm profile PDF, and a link to the Nexiris Consultants website.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with brand colors (minty blue palette, frost whites, dark navy), custom fonts (Montserrat/Inter), box shadows, border radii, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking the current version, feature summary, architectural decisions, known issues, and existing feature list for the Nexiris Global institutional website build.
